propositions: ADR 0035 §(d) lacks concrete backend interface specification, blocking decomposition of Phase 2 implementation stories (S2–S5) that require Protocol names

Backend interface must pin four design decisions: canonical model (rebar ticket), role Protocols behind Backend facade, RemoteRef type for vendor identity tuples, and registry keyed on config.reconciler.backend
Current coupling hardcodes 'jira' literals and bare jira_key values in apply_inbound_records.py that must be replaced with RemoteRef abstraction

Core reconciler owns diff/apply logic; adapters read and enact only via role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention, opt-in capability Protocols)

Revised ADR scope includes role-Protocol table, Backend facade, RemoteRef, registry, three leak-fixes, and proof-of-seam via contract suite and test-only FakeBackend; real GitHub adapter deferred to epic be74
Documentation-only change to ADR file must pass lint validation and reference correct epics (bbf1 for Phase 2, be74 for second backend implementation)
